server_specifications.starting_level: Level 80 (New players start directly at Lv 80)
server_specifications.starter_gear: Auto Equip gives +6 FB items up to Lv 79. Rook NPC in Donwhang provides starter beginner rewards.
server_specifications.union_limit: 2 Guilds per Union (Jangan Fortress has 2 Union limit, Bandit Fortress is No Union)
server_specifications.daily_gold_limit: 350M Gold (Increases to 500M Gold on weekends: Friday/Saturday/Sunday)

alchemy_system.max_plus: +10 without ADV (Maximum plus with ADV C is +12 or +13 glow)
alchemy_system.elixirs_upgrading: 100 normal elixirs + 2.5M Gold + 5 Arena Coins -> 50 SOS Elixirs (Elixir SOX Upgrader in NPC). SOS Elixirs can be upgraded into Moon Elixirs.
alchemy_system.lucky_scrolls: 2% Lucky Scrolls stack to 1k. 100x 2% Lucky Scrolls can be converted into 1x 3% Lucky Scroll (via Lucky Scroll Upgrader). Craftable 3% Lucky with Mining Elements.

adv_elixirs.adv_c_weapon_cracker: ADV C Weapon Cracker Scroll in NPC converts +10 SOX Weapon into ADV C SOX (+2 plus bonus, gives +13 glow). The original weapon is sacrificed/destroyed in the process.
adv_elixirs.adv_c_normal: ADV C Normal for all item types available via Magic POP and Normal ADV Box (cannot break +10 for ADV C normal).

alchemy_system.alchemy_boosters: Super Alchemy Reinforce Booster costs 150M gold and lasts 100 minutes. Fast Alchemy enabled in events.

seal_of_moon_guide.description: How Seal of Moon (SOM) crafting works in Exilium:
steps: 1. Drop untradeable 'Dead Moon Items' + corresponding Fragments inside Dungeons (HWT, Server Dungeon, Guild Dungeon).
2. Break unwanted Dead Moon Items with 'Moon Hammer' (bought from NPC) to gain extra fragments.
3. Buy 'Seal of Life' from NPC and use it on the Dead Moon Item to awaken it (reveals real fragment crafting requirement instead of 9999).
4. Craft the Dead Moon Item with required Fragments in the standard Alchemy Window.
5. Untradeable accessories can be destroyed with 'Dead Hammer' for fragments.
seal_of_moon_guide.moon_weapon_switchers: Nesta NPC offers Weapon Switchers for Moon Weapons (keeps the same plus and same stats/blues). Cost: 25 Event Coins, 250 Arena Coins, 500M Gold.

item_points_requirements.holy_water_temple: 4,000 Item Points (4-party dungeon, drops all elements)
item_points_requirements.party_dungeon: 3,850 Item Points (Boss has chance for ADV SoS Box/Lamp/10M Goldbar)
item_points_requirements.general_jobbing: 4,000 Item Points requirement was removed (open to all, except Aqua route)

job_system_details.triangle: Classic Hunter vs Thief vs Trader dynamic.
job_system_details.job_quests: Job Quests award 100% Job EXP, but player MUST be wearing their Job Suit when delivering the quests. Job temple mob quest requires 500 mobs.
job_system_details.job_suit_npc: Job Suit Breaker in Job Suit NPC destroys unwanted Job Suit and safely refunds Gold & Arena Coins back to player storage.
job_system_details.job_reverse: Special Thief Job Reverse cooldown is 90 seconds.
job_system_details.job_coins: Untradeable Job Coins awarded from daily job quests (15 kills daily quest).
job_system_details.job_remover: Job Remover available in Gift Silk Shop and for 75M Gold.
job_system_details.mercenaries: Guild Masters can purchase Mercenaries from NPC without job level restrictions.

fortress_war.jangan_fortress: Sunday 14:30 - 15:30 Server Time (2 Union limit). Winner receives Behemoth pet / Dark Lizard.
fortress_war.bandit_fortress: Sunday 16:30 - 17:30 Server Time (Balanced, No Union allowed).

major_events_and_schedules.weekly_ranking_reset: Resets every Sunday at 18:00 Server Time. Rewards: Top 1 Player (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Guild Master (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Jobber (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Battle Royale (1,000 Silk), Top 1 LoL (1,000 Silk).
major_events_and_schedules.chaos_job_event: Daily at 23:30 Server Time. Features Evil Terra, Evil Pyrex, Evil Kryon, Evil Dragon King (STR/INT), 8 Treasure Boxes spawn before Dragon. Each kill grants 1 Moon Elixir + 1 Event Coin.
major_events_and_schedules.evil_unique_takeover: Daily at 15:55 Server Time. All Evil Uniques spawn together across the map.
major_events_and_schedules.halloween_event: Evil Pumpkin Event every 6 hours (STR/INT in Job Temple treasure spawns). Drops Halloween Box (Halloween avatar/pick pet, random 1-500 Gift Silk, 1-25 Arena coins) + Evil Lamp + 15 Moon Elements.
major_events_and_schedules.earth_ghost_race: Replaces 4v4 survival in Togui Village (first to teleport wins).
major_events_and_schedules.anubis_and_isis: 21:45 Server Time daily. Drops 100% 1 SOS each, 1-25 Arena coins in chest, 3x Lamps, 10 Event Coins, 25% ADV C Normal.
major_events_and_schedules.selket_and_neith: Job Temple Uniques. Drops 3% Lucky Scroll 100%, 10 Event Coins, 25% ADV C Normal in chest.
major_events_and_schedules.evil_uniques_spawn: Evil Uniques (Evil Frostclaw STR, Evil Kong STR, Evil Elder, etc.) spawn every 4 hours.
major_events_and_schedules.roc_event: Roc INT and Death Bone STR spawn at Donwhang South. Resurrection cooldown inside Roc is 30 seconds. Drops ADV SOS Box.
major_events_and_schedules.medusa: Solo Medusa only (Balanced STR + INT). Drops 1 ADV SOS Box + Lamp for everyone in chest.
major_events_and_schedules.battle_arena: Random team matching. Requires 3,500 Item Points. Winner: 20 Arena coins, 20M gold, 2 Event Tokens, 200 Gift Silk. Loser: 10 Arena coins, 10M gold, 1 Event Token, 100 Gift Silk.

currencies_and_shops.silk: Official premium currency. Acquired via donation on website (https://exiliumonline.com/account/store) or winning weekly ranks.
currencies_and_shops.gift_silk: Earned by playing and participating. Gift Silk Converter converts 500 Gift Silk into 100 Tradeable Silk in VIP/Season room.
currencies_and_shops.event_coins: Earned by participating in events, killing Server Dungeon Uniques, Treasure boxes, Fortress War (15 coins for joining). Triple (3x) Event Coins on weekends (Fri/Sat/Sun). Can be sold for 10x Exilium Tokens in NPC.
currencies_and_shops.arena_coins: Obtained from Battle Arena, quests, fishing NPC (1-25 coins for 2 tokens), and dungeon chests.
currencies_and_shops.season_points: Earned from PvP kills in events, job temple, and using Card collections (50 Season Points per card used).

terms_and_donation_policy.payment_processors: PayPal, MercadoPago, HipoPay, Binance Pay, Credit/Debit cards, local payment channels.
terms_and_donation_policy.no_refund_policy: All digital goods and Silk are delivered instantly upon purchase and are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances.
terms_and_donation_policy.chargeback_penalty: Initiating a dispute or chargeback will be deemed fraud and results in an immediate permanent ban (IP & HWID lock).
terms_and_donation_policy.password_security: Exilium Online staff will NEVER ask for your password.
terms_and_donation_policy.off_market_trading: Off-market real-money transactions (RMT) outside official server mechanisms are strictly prohibited.

common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Server under maintenance, port 15779 blocked, or firewall/antivirus issue.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. تأكد من قناة #announcements أو #server-status إذا كان هناك صيانة.
2. أضف مجلد Exilium كاملاً لقائمة الاستثناءات (Exclusions) في Windows Defender.
3. أعد تشغيل الراوتر لتجديد عنوان الـ IP.
4. افتح اللعبة دائماً من اللانشر كمسؤول (Run as Admin).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Check #announcements or #server-status to see if maintenance is ongoing.
2. Add the Exilium folder to your Windows Defender/Antivirus exclusions.
3. Restart your internet router to refresh your IP.
4. Always run the Launcher as Administrator.

common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Outdated client requiring the latest patch.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: افتح اللانشر كمسؤول ليقوم بتحميل آخر تحديث (Update). إذا استمرت المشكلة، حمّل ملف Media.pk2 الجديد من قناة #downloads واستبدله في مجلد اللعبة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Run your Launcher as Administrator to download the latest patch. If it fails, download the updated Media.pk2 from #downloads and replace it inside your game directory.

common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Antivirus quarantined sro_client.exe as false positive or missing runtimes.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. افتح Windows Security > Protection History واضغط Restore لملف sro_client.exe.
2. أضف مجلد اللعبة إلى Exclusions.
3. قم بتثبيت حزمة Visual C++ All-in-One وDirectX 9.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Open Windows Security > Protection History and Restore sro_client.exe.
2. Add the game folder to Exclusions.
3. Install Visual C++ All-in-One Runtimes and DirectX 9.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Character Stuck / Instant DC After Relog
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Character stuck in a bugged state, corrupted position, or crashed alchemy state causing instant disconnection upon login.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: لا يوجد زر فك تعليق على الموقع في إكسيليوم. يجب على اللاعب تزويد البوت باسم الشخصية (IGN)، ويتم عمل منشن فوراً لـ @Astro و @STAM لمراجعة قاعدة البيانات وإصلاح موضع الشخصية/العنصر في السيرفر، مع بقاء اللاعب غير متصل (Offline) حتى يتم التأكيد.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: There is no website unstick button. The player must provide their Character Name (IGN), and the ticket is escalated to @Astro and @STAM to check server database logs and teleport/fix the character while the player remains offline.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: BSObj Plugin: can't create file transfer manager! Maybe pack file corrupted or someone is already accessing it now
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: sro_client.exe or silkroad.exe is running in background holding lock on pk2 files, or launcher needs update.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. افتح Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc) وابحث عن sro_client.exe و silkroad.exe واضغط End Task.
2. افتح اللانشر كمسؤول (Run as Admin) لتحديث اللعبة.
3. حل أسهل: أعد تشغيل جهاز الكمبيوتر وافتح اللانشر كمسؤول.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
Method 1: Open Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc), find sro_client.exe and silkroad.exe in Processes and End Task, then reopen Launcher as Admin.
Easier Solution: Restart your computer, then open the Exilium Launcher (silkroad.exe) as Administrator to update your client.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Windows Defender blocking / deleting sro_client.exe or client closed immediately
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows Defender update falsely detecting game files as virus (false positive).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. استثنِ مجلد Exilium كاملاً من Windows Defender: افتح Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions > Add exclusion > Folder واخر مجلد اللعبة.
2. إذا تم حذف الملف: افتح Protection History واضغط Actions > Restore لملف sro_client.exe.
3. إذا استمرت المشكلة حمّل ملفات الكلاينت النظيفة من موقع السيرفر exiliumonline.com أو روابط التحميل الرسمية المباشرة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Exclude the Exilium folder from Windows Defender: Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions > Add folder > select your Exilium folder.
2. Open Protection History and click 'Restore' on sro_client.exe.
3. If files are corrupted, download clean files from official website exiliumonline.com or official direct mirrors.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Windows 11 Clientless / Frequent Disconnects / Random Game Crash
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows 11 windowed gaming optimizations and GPU switching interfering with game client.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. كليك يمين على سطح المكتب واضغط Display settings.
2. انزل واضغط Graphics.
3. اضغط Browse وحدد ملف sro_client.exe من مجلد Exilium.
4. اضغط على sro_client.exe بالقائمة واختر Options.
5. اختر High performance (كرت الشاشة الخارجي).
6. فعّل خيار Don't use optimizations for windowed games.
7. اضغط Save وأعد تشغيل اللعبة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Right-click desktop -> select 'Display settings'.
2. Scroll down and click 'Graphics'.
3. Click 'Browse' -> find and select 'sro_client.exe' from your Exilium folder.
4. Find 'sro_client.exe' on the list and click 'Options'.
5. Select 'High performance' (dedicated GPU).
6. Check 'Don't use optimizations for windowed games'.
7. Click 'Save' and restart Exilium.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Auto Login Macro SRO_Client Crash or Immediate Close
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows Defender or Data Execution Prevention (DEP) blocking modified vSRO executables or third-party auto-login macro tools.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. أنشئ مجلد جديد على الكمبيوتر باسم SRO وأضفه إلى قائمة الاستثناءات (Exclusions) في Windows Defender.
2. ضع ملفات اللعبة بداخل هذا المجلد.
3. أضف ملفات Replacer.exe و Silkroad.exe و SRO_Client.exe إلى إعدادات الـ DEP (Data Execution Prevention).
4. شغل كل ملف (Macro Auto Login, Replacer, Silkroad, SRO_Client) مرة واحدة كمسؤول (Run as Administrator). إذا ظهر تحذير فايروسات الويندوز اضغط على More Info ثم Run anyway.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Create a folder named SRO on your PC and add it to Windows Defender Exclusions.
2. Extract the game client inside this folder.
3. Add Replacer.exe, Silkroad.exe, and SRO_Client.exe to your Windows DEP settings.
4. Run Macro Auto Login, Replacer, Silkroad, and SRO_Client once each as Administrator. If a Windows warning appears, click 'More info' then 'Run anyway'.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Disconnection Upon Entering Game / Specific Region Crash (e.g. Samarkand / Frozen Dungeon)
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Corrupted map/teleport index files or missing client files during updates, often resolved by specific teleport routing or updating client paths.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. إذا واجهت فصل (DC) عند دخول اللعبة أو عند الانتقال لمنطقة معينة، استخدم المنفذ البديل (مثل الانتقال من Donwhang إلى آسيا الصغرى بدلاً من السفر المباشر).
2. تأكد من إيقاف تشغيل Windows Defender أثناء فك ضغط التحديثات.
3. قم بتطبيق ملفات الـ DLL المحسنة المقدمة من السيرفر لمنع الكראשات.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. If you disconnect when entering specific areas (like Samarkand), use alternative teleports (e.g., teleport from DW to Asia Minor).
2. Ensure Windows Defender is disabled when extracting game patches.
3. Apply the server's provided DLL updates designed to fix client crashes and disconnections.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Missing D3DX9 / Visual C++ Runtime Errors
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Missing core DirectX 9 or Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable packages required by the vSRO client graphics engine.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: قم بتحميل وتثبيت حزم الفويزيوال سي بلس بلس (Visual C++ Redistributable) وخطوط وملفات دايركت إكس 9 (DirectX 9) الناقصة في نظام التشغيل لديك ثم إعادة تشغيل الكمبيوتر.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Download and install the missing Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable packages and DirectX 9 runtime components, then restart your PC.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Player gets disconnected (DC) and loses currency/items when trying to purchase items (like Immo) using gift silk.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: تحقق من سجلات الخادم (Server Logs) لمعرفة ما إذا تمت عملية الشخصية وخصم العملة (مثل 300m)، وإذا لم يتم تسليم العنصر، قم بإضافته يدويًا أو رد العملة للمتسبب في المشكلة التقنية.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Check server logs to verify if currency was deducted and the purchase failed. If the item wasn't delivered, manually deliver the item or refund the currency.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Exile Dracarys Golden Dragon pet has lower movement speed than other fellow pets.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: تم توثيق المشكلة وإحالتها إلى فريق الإدارة والتطوير لمراجعة قيم وسرعة الحيوان الأليف في ملفات اللعبة وإصلاحها في التحديث القادم.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Noted and escalated to the management team to investigate game data and stats for the pet's movement speed and apply a fix.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: BSObj Plugin Error / Launcher Won't Open
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Player clicks launcher and nothing happens, or when opening ExiliumClient directly, they get a 'BSObj Plugin' error.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: 1. افتح مدير المهام (Ctrl + Shift + Esc)، وابحث عن أي عمليات تعمل لـ `sro_client.exe` أو `silkroad.exe` واضغط 'إنهاء المهمة'. 2. أعد تشغيل الكمبيوتر. 3. شغل دائماً من أيقونة **silkroad.exe** كمسؤول (ولا تستخدم ExiliumClient مطلقاً).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: 1. Open Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc), find running instances of `sro_client.exe` or `silkroad.exe` under Processes and click 'End Task'. 2. Restart PC. 3. Always launch the game using **silkroad.exe** as Administrator (never ExiliumClient).

common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Game closes instantly or goes clientless on Windows 11 upon startup.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: 1. اذهب إلى إعدادات ويندوز > الشاشة > الرسومات (Graphics). 2. اضغط تصفح واختر ملف `sro_client.exe`. 3. اضغط خيارات > اختر 'أداء عالي' (High performance) وفعّل خيار عدم استخدام تحسينات ألعاب النوافذ. احفظ الإعدادات وشغل اللعبة كمسؤول.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: 1. Go to Windows Settings > Display > Graphics. 2. Browse and select `sro_client.exe`. 3. Click Options > select 'High Performance' and check 'Don't use optimizations for windowed games'. Save and restart launcher as Admin.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Model Switcher Not Working / Failed to Switch
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: The weapon currently has an active Glow effect (like Bloody Glow) preventing the model switcher from applying, or requires manual server application.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. إذا كان السلاح عليه أي تأثير توهج (Glow مثل Bloody Glow)، يجب إزالة التوهج أولاً والمحاولة مجدداً.
2. إذا استمرت المشكلة: ضع السلاح والـ Switcher في الصفحة الأولى (Page 1) من الحقيبة، وقم بتسجيل الخروج تماماً (Log Off)، وسيتم عمل منشن لـ @STAM لتطبيقه لك يدوياً من السيرفر.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. If the weapon has an active Glow effect (such as Bloody Glow), remove the glow first and try again.
2. If it still doesn't work: place the weapon and switcher on the first page of your inventory, log off the game completely, and tag @STAM to apply it manually on the server.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Sold Weapon or Job Suit to NPC by Mistake
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Player accidentally sold valuable gear, weapon, or job suit to an NPC shop.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: اطلب من اللاعب اسم الشخصية بدقة وتفاصيل العنصر المباع، ثم قم بتصعيد التذكرة إلى @STAM وفريق الإدارة للتحقق من السجلات واستعادة العنصر يدوياً.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Ask the player for their exact character name and item details, then escalate the ticket to @STAM and the Admin team for in-game log verification and manual item restoration.

common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Player experiences Error C9 when trying to connect to the game server.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: 1. تحقق من قناة #announcements في ديسكورد للتأكد من عدم وجود صيانة بالسيرفر. 2. أضف مجلد اللعبة كاملاً إلى استثناءات مضاد الفيروسات. 3. أعد تشغيل راوتر الإنترنت لتجديد عنوان IP.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: 1. Check Discord #announcements to ensure server maintenance is not underway. 2. Add the entire Exilium folder to Windows Defender/Antivirus exclusions. 3. Restart internet router to refresh IP.

escalation_reasons: Donations, payments, or Silk not received after purchasing
Account theft, stolen items, or lost credentials
Reporting hackers, bots in jobs, or exploiting bugs with proof
Severe technical server bugs not documented
Direct request to speak with human Admin / Owner

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do I claim my starting items and packages if they don't appear?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف أستلم الحزمة البديلة أو أدوات البداية إذا لم تظهر في الشخصية؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: Starting packages, SP, and auto-equip gear are delivered automatically or through the character chest/inventory upon character creation or reaching specific milestones. If delayed, wait a short moment or check your inventory/storage chest.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: يتم تسليم حزم البداية ونقاط الـ SP وأدوات الـ Auto Equip تلقائياً في صندوق الشخصية (Chest) أو الحقيبة عند إنشاء الشخصية أو الوصول لمستويات محددة. إذا تأخرت، انتظر قليلاً أو تفقد صندوق التخزين.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: What is the maximum IP/PC character limit in the game?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: ما هو الحد الأقصى المسموح به لفتح الشخصيات بنفس الجهاز (IP/PC Limit)؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: The IP/PC character limit is set to 8 characters per hardware/connection.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: الحد الأقصى المسموح به لفتح الشخصيات بنفس الجهاز (IP/PC Limit) هو 8 شخصيات.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: Can I do both Trading and Thiefing without hitting a joint limit?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: هل يمكنني العمل كتاجر (Trader) وكرصاع/سرّاق (Thief) في نفس الوقت دون تأثر الحد الأقصى للذهب؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: Yes! Thiefing profit does not count towards the daily trader limit. You can max out your trader earnings and still make extra money through thiefing.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en_alt: Yes, thiefing does not belong to the trader limit. You can make your maximum profit from trading and then go thiefing to earn additional gold on top.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: نعم! أرباح السرقة (Thiefing) لا تتبع حد التاجر اليومي. يمكنك تحقيق الحد الأقصى المسموح به من التجارة ثم العمل كسرّاق لتحقيق أموال إضافية فوقها.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do Honor Buffs work if they don't appear in my buff list?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف تعمل بوفات الشرف (Honor Buffs) إذا لم تظهر في قائمة البوفات الخاصة بي؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: If honor points and buffs have been refreshed, you need to un-equip and re-equip your job suit once to update and display your honor buffs correctly.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: إذا تم تحديث نقاط الشرف ولم تظهر البوفات لديك، كل ما عليك فعله هو إزالة بدلة العمل (Job Suit) وإعادة ارتداؤها مرة واحدة لتظهر البوفات بشكل صحيح.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do I participate in Equalized/Balanced Events properly?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف أشارك في الفعاليات المتوازنة (Balanced/Equalized Events) بشكل صحيح دون مشاكل في العتاد؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: For equalized and balanced events, place your secondary weapons or shields in the 1st and 2nd slots of your inventory to ensure proper scaling and functioning.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: بالنسبة للفعاليات المتوازنة والمتساوية، يجب وضع الأسلحة الثانوية أو الدروع في الخانتين الأولى والثانية (1st and 2nd slots) من الحقيبة لضمان عمل النظام بشكل صحيح.

escalation_and_mention_rules.trigger_scenario: In-Game Disconnect (DC) or Item Purchase Glitch (Gift Silk / Item Mall / Immo)
escalation_and_mention_rules.action: Notify the player to provide transaction details, username, and IGN, and ping support roles if unresolved.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_ar: عندما يبلغ اللاعب عن فصل الاتصال (DC) أو مشكلة في شراء العناصر من متجر الهدايا (Gift Silk)، اطلب منه تفاصيل الحساب وقم بالإشارة إلى فريق الدعم.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_en: When a player reports a disconnect or an item purchase issue via gift silk, ask for their account details and tag the support team.

escalation_and_mention_rules.trigger_scenario: Game Balance, Stat Discrepancies, or Pet Speed Bug (e.g., Exile Dracarys Golden Dragon)
escalation_and_mention_rules.action: Acknowledge the report, inform the player that game data check is required, and escalate to management/developers.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_ar: عندما يتعلق الأمر بمشاكل إحصائيات اللعبة أو سرعة الحيوانات الأليفة التي تتطلب فحص بيانات اللعبة، قم بإخطار الإدارة وفريق التطوير.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_en: When it concerns game stats or pet speed discrepancies requiring a game data check, notify management and developers.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Welcome to Exilium! Your request for the Starter Package has been submitted to the administration for confirmation. Mention @STAM and staff roles for quick approval.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أهلاً بك في إكسيليوم! تم إرسال طلبك للحزمة الترحيبية إلى الإدارة للمراجعة والتاكيد. تم عمل منشن للإدارة للمتابعة.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Provide the web store link (exiliumonline.com/account/store). If the player paid and didn't receive silk, ask for their account ID/transaction ID and tag @STAM immediately.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: قم بتزويد اللاعب برابط المتجر (exiliumonline.com/account/store). إذا قام بالدفع ولم يتصل السيل، اطلب رقم الحساب أو تفاصيل التحويل وقم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM فوراً.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: In-game bug / character stuck / error C9
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Ask for the player's IGN, instruct them to stay logged off, and mention @Astro and @STAM to fix the character in the database.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: اطلب اسم الشخصية (IGN)، واطلب من اللاعب البقاء أوفلاين، وقم بعمل منشن لـ @Astro و @STAM لإصلاح الشخصية في السيرفر.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: Scam or player conflict / item loss / wrong NPC sale
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Acknowledge the item loss or wrong NPC sale. Ask for the character name and exact item details, then tag @STAM and Admin team for manual in-game inspection and restoration.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أكد على مشكلة ضياع العنصر أو بيعه بالخطأ للتاجر. اطلب اسم الشخصية وتفاصيل العنصر بدقة، ثم قم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM وفريق الإدارة للمراجعة اليدوية والاسترجاع.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Inform the player that ban appeals must be reviewed by management. Tag @STAM and management roles directly to handle the appeal.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أبلغ اللاعب أن طلبات إلغاء الحظر تتم مراجعتها حصرياً بواسطة الإدارة العليا. قم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM وفريق الإدارة للتعامل مع الطلب.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: General FAQ / Download / Alchemy rate / Client links
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Provide direct download mirrors (Direct link, Mega, Google Drive, MediaFire) or explain server rates and game features directly without mentioning staff.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: قم بتزويد روابط التحميل المباشرة والمرايا (ميجا، جوجل درايف، ميديافاير) أو اشرح معدلات السيرفر وخصائص اللعبة مباشرة دون الحاجة لعمل منشن لأي مشرف.

common_problems.problem_title: Model Switcher Not Working / Failing to Use
common_problems.problem_title_ar: مبدل الموديل لا يعمل / يفشل الاستخدام
symptoms: Getting 'failed to use switch model' error message
Item switcher scroll won't apply to weapon or shield
Model skin showing incorrectly or defaulting to a different degree (e.g. Egy B showing as Egy A)
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What weapon/shield are you trying to use it on?
What specific model degree or type are you trying to apply (e.g., D15, D16, Egy A, Egy B)?
Did you place the model switcher scroll in the first slot?
Does the weapon currently have a glow or active alchemy that conflicts?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
Provide a screenshot or video showing the item, model switcher scroll, and error/behavior
Wear or equip the item in-game for staff inspection
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff inspects the item via database/tools, ensures it is placed in the correct slot, checks for conflicting glows, and applies the fix directly or instructs the player to teleport (tp once) after the backend adjustment.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم الطاقم بفحص الأداة عبر قاعدة البيانات/الأدوات، والتأكد من وضعها في الخانة الصحيحة، والتحقق من وجود تأثيرات متضاربة، ثم تطبيق الإصلاح مباشرة أو طلب الانتقال الفضائي (Teleport) من اللاعب.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When the model switcher scroll consistently fails or bugs out on specific high-tier items (like Egy A/B or D15/D16 shields/spears) requiring database-level intervention.

common_problems.problem_title: Glows Disappearing or Not Showing After Model Switch
common_problems.problem_title_ar: اختفاء التوهج (Glow) أو عدم ظهوره بعد تغيير الموديل
symptoms: Weapon or shield does not show any glow after applying a model switcher
Glow item disappeared upon use
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Which weapon or shield are you using?
What model and glow combination were you trying to apply (e.g. blood glow + adv b + egy b)?
required_player_actions: Remove current glow temporarily to test
Provide screenshots or video evidence of the weapon lacking the glow
Keep the item equipped in inventory
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff verifies item state, instructs player to temporarily remove existing glows or test weapon state, and manually corrects the weapon skin/glow mapping in the database if bugged.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يتحقق الطاقم من حالة الأداة، ويطلب من اللاعب إزالة التوهجات الحالية مؤقتاً للاختبار، ويقوم بإصلاح ربط الموديل/التوهج يدوياً في قاعدة البيانات إذا كان هناك خلل.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When a glow or advanced alchemy modifier bugs out or vanishes during a model switch.

common_problems.problem_title: Model Switcher Box Closed Without Choosing / Lost Box
common_problems.problem_title_ar: إغلاق صندوق مبدل الموديل دون اختيار / ضياع الصندوق
symptoms: Battle Pass model switcher box disappeared because the UI was closed before making a selection
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Which box or switcher reward are you claiming?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff verifies the missing box/reward and re-adds a new model switcher box to the player's chest or inventory.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يتحقق الطاقم من الصندوق/الجائزة المفقودة ويقوم بإضافة صندوق مبدل موديل جديد إلى صندوق أو مخزن اللاعب.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Immediately when a player accidentally closes a reward selection box and requests a replacement.

staff_golden_rules: Always ask for the Character Name (IGN), weapon type, and exact model degree before troubleshooting.
Require screenshots or short video recordings (.mov/.png) of the item, inventory slot, and error message.

Changing a model switcher does not require removing the old model first; players can directly activate/switch to the new model (old model is replaced/deleted without refund unless specified otherwise).
Never process item restorations or manual model fixes without verifying item placement in the first slot or checking the item in-game via equipped state.

common_problems.problem_title: Character Stuck and Disconnecting on Login
common_problems.problem_title_ar: الشخصية عالقة وتفصل عند تسجيل الدخول
symptoms: Instant DC upon logging into the character
Character is stuck after a crash or event/dungeon
Cannot move or use reverse/restart
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Where did you crash or get stuck (e.g. event, dungeon, specific area)?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
Log into your account at exiliumonline.com and use the Char Unstick feature
Stay offline while staff handles manual intervention if needed
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Log into your account at exiliumonline.com and use the Char Unstick feature to teleport your character to Jangan. If it fails or you continue to DC, provide your IGN so an Admin or Staff member (@Astro, @STAM) can manually move or fix your character from the database side.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: سجل الدخول إلى حسابك على موقع exiliumonline.com واستخدم ميزة فك تعليق الشخصية (Char Unstick) لنقل شخصيتك إلى جانجان. إذا استمرت المشكلة، أعطنا اسم الشخصية (IGN) لكي يقوم أحد المشرفين بنقلك يدوياً.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When the website's Char Unstick feature fails or the player experiences continuous instant disconnects upon logging in.

common_problems.problem_title: Stuck After Event or Dungeon Crash (League, Blazing, Alchemy Room)
common_problems.problem_title_ar: العلقان بعد الخروج أو الفصل المفاجئ داخل الفعاليات أو الدنجن
symptoms: Disappearing pillars/bosses after reconnecting
Missing buffs, stats, or items after an event/dungeon crash
Respawning incorrectly with reset skills or stuck in an event area
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Did you disconnect while inside an event or dungeon like League of Legends or Blazing Dungeon?
Did you try to teleport once?
required_player_actions: Teleport one time (e.g. from Jangan to Hotan or back to town)
Provide screenshots if necessary
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Teleport once (e.g. using a teleport/return script to another town) to refresh your session data and sync your character state after crashing inside an equalized event or dungeon. If quest progress or items are lost due to server bugs/crashes, provide your IGN and details for staff review.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: قم بالانتقال (التيلبرت) مرة واحدة إلى مدينة أخرى لتحديث بيانات الجلسة ومزامنة حالة الشخصية بعد الفصل داخل الفعالية أو الدنجن. إذا فقدت أغراض أو تقدم بسبب كراش السيرفر، يرجى تزويدنا باسم الشخصية.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When teleporting does not restore missing dungeon progress, entry tokens, or bugged items.

staff_golden_rules: Always instruct players to try the website's 'Char Unstick' feature first before requesting manual staff intervention.
For event/dungeon related sync issues or missing buffs/items after a crash, always ask the player to teleport at least once before escalating.
Always collect the exact Character Name (IGN) and screenshots when database checks or manual admin unsticks are required.

common_problems.problem_title: Incorrect Binance ID Provided for Payouts/Donations
common_problems.problem_title_ar: رابط أو معرف بايننس غير صحيح لعمليات الدفع أو التبرع
symptoms: Funds or money did not drop/arrive
Transaction delayed due to wrong ID digits
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Binance ID?
Can you verify your payment credentials?
required_player_actions: Provide correct Binance ID
Check account details for missing numbers
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff identified that the player's Binance ID was missing a digit (e.g., incomplete ID like 372060546). Player must provide the correct, complete Binance ID so staff can verify and process the transaction.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: قام طاقم العمل بتحديد أن معرف بايننس الخاص باللاعب كان ينقصه رقم. يجب على اللاعب تقديم معرف بايننس الصحيح والمكتمل ليتمكن الطاقم من التحقق ومعالجة المعاملة.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When payment/payout fails to arrive due to mismatched or incorrect account IDs.

common_problems.problem_title: Wallet Feature Disabled / Converting Wallet Balance to Silks
common_problems.problem_title_ar: خاصية المحفظة معطلة / تحويل رصيد المحفظة إلى سيلك
symptoms: Player wants to withdraw USD/$ from wallet
Wallet is disabled
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your account name or character name?
Do you want to transfer the amount for silks?
required_player_actions: State desired amount to transfer
Request silk conversion instead of wallet withdrawal
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff clarifies that the wallet feature was disabled a month ago. However, players can transfer their accumulated wallet amount directly into silks through staff assistance.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: وضح طاقم العمل أن خاصية المحفظة تم تعطيلها قبل شهر. ومع ذلك، يمكن للاعبين تحويل مبلغ المحفظة الخاص بهم مباشرة إلى سيلك بمساعدة الطاقم.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When a player inquires about old wallet balances or needs manual conversion to silks.

common_problems.problem_title: Accessing Special Store Bonuses After Website Login
common_problems.problem_title_ar: الوصول إلى مكافآت المتجر الخاصة بعد تسجيل الدخول للموقع
symptoms: Player asking where to find bonuses or store specials
Unfamiliar with website store layout
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Have you logged into the website store?
required_player_actions: Log in to https://www.exiliumonline.com/account/store
Navigate to the Silk Store Menu
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Direct the player to log in via the official Exilium store website (www.exiliumonline.com/account/store), where special bonuses can be found directly through the Silk Store Menu.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: توجيه اللاعب لتسجيل الدخول عبر موقع متجر إكسيليوم الرسمي، حيث يمكن العثور على المكافآت الخاصة من خلال قائمة متجر السيلك.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When players need guidance regarding website account features or store navigation.

staff_golden_rules: Always verify the player's correct payment credentials (such as Binance ID digits) before processing financial or donation issues.
Direct players to the official website store link (exiliumonline.com/account/store) for store bonuses and account balance management.
If the direct wallet withdrawal feature is disabled, offer the alternative option to transfer available balances into silks.

common_problems.problem_title: Sold Job Suit or Weapon/Item to NPC
common_problems.problem_title_ar: بيع بدلة العمل أو السلاح/الأغراض للـ NPC بالخطأ
symptoms: Sold special job suit (trader/thief) or gear to NPC
Cannot rebuy or didn't get refunded properly
Accidentally destroyed or sold high-plus item (+11 shield, spear, etc.)
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Which item/suit did you sell or lose?
Did you try to check the NPC buyback tab or hammer?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
Specify exact details of the lost item
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff checks server database logs to verify the item sale timestamp and details (e.g., using Astro's DB lookup logs), then manually restores or refunds the item if verified.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم طاقم العمل بفحص سجلات قاعدة بيانات السيرفر للتحقق من تفاصيل ووقت بيع الأغراض، ثم استرجاعها أو تعويض اللاعب يدويًا.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Escalate to Database/Dev team when a player accidentally sells a valuable item (+11 or job suit) and cannot rebuy it back from the NPC.

common_problems.problem_title: Server Disconnect or Rollback Causing Missing Items/Skills
common_problems.problem_title_ar: انقطاع الاتصال أو التراجع يتسبب في اختفاء الأغراض أو المهارات
symptoms: Got disconnected after an event/league of legends/crash
Logged back in and character appeared reset or missing specific items/skills/tokens
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
What exact items or tokens are missing?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
List missing items clearly
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Wait for server maintenance or developer verification. The admin/dev checks logs, fixes the bug or server state, and restores the items exactly as they were.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: الانتظار حتى صيانة السيرفر أو فحص المطور، حيث يقوم المطور بمراجعة السجلات وإعادة الأغراض المفقودة كما كانت.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When items or skills disappear due to a server crash or rollback issue requiring database restoration.

common_problems.problem_title: Accidental Wrong Purchase from NPC
common_problems.problem_title_ar: شراء غرض خاطئ من الـ NPC بالخطأ
symptoms: Bought the wrong weapon, upgrade item, or too many potions (e.g., 10k berserk potions)
Bought lucky mask instead of lucky mask upgrader
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
What did you buy by mistake and what do you actually need?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
Stay offline or wait for staff instruction
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff checks the transaction, takes note of the wrong item, and swaps or refunds the correct item/currency after developer review.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم طاقم العمل بفحص المعاملة واستبدال أو تعويض الغرض الصحيح بعد مراجعة المطور.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When a player requests a swap or refund for an accidental NPC purchase.

staff_golden_rules: Always ask for the player's Character Name (IGN) first before investigating logs.
Check the NPC buyback or hammer option first before escalating to developers for item sales.
Database log checks (SQL queries) for sold/deleted items must be performed by Developers or designated Admins (.astro1337 / zaxxon.1).
Never process refunds or item restorations without verifying database logs and exact item attributes (OptLvl, Stats, Plus).

common_problems.problem_title: Cannot add blues or attributes to Avatar items
common_problems.problem_title_ar: لا يمكن إضافة البلورات أو الخصائص إلى أزياء الأفاتار
symptoms: Player cannot apply blues to avatar
Error or failure when attempting to drag stones to avatar
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Are you using avatar-specific magic stones?
Provide a clear screenshot of the issue.
required_player_actions: Obtain correct Avatar Magic Stones from events, Magic POP, or activities
Drag the magic stones onto the avatar item in the inventory window
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Avatar blues/attributes in Exilium can only be added using Avatar Magic Stones. Ensure you are using the correct Magic Stones specifically for avatars, and drag them onto your avatar item in your inventory window.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: بلورات وخصائص الأفاتار في إكسيليوم يتم إضافتها فقط باستخدام أحجار سحر الأفاتار المخصصة. تأكد من استخدام الأحجار الصحيحة الخاصة بالأفاتار واسحبها فوق عنصر الأفاتار في نافذة الحقيبة.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Escalate if the player provides proof of using correct stones and experiencing a confirmed game bug.

common_problems.problem_title: Pet movement speed discrepancy or bugs
common_problems.problem_title_ar: مشكلة في اختلاف سرعة حركة الحيوانات الأليفة أو أخطائها
symptoms: Pet movement speed is not the same
Abnormal pet behavior or movement
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Which specific pet are you using?
Provide screenshots or details of the speed difference.
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
Provide details or screenshots of the bug
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff takes the report for verification. Player is asked to provide details/screenshots so the team can investigate the pet mechanics.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم طاقم العمل بتسجيل البلاغ للتحقق. يُطلب من اللاعب تقديم التفاصيل أو لقطات الشاشة لكي يتمكن الفريق من التحقق من خصائص الحيوان الأليف.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Always notify the team for verification when game mechanics or movement discrepancies are reported.

common_problems.problem_title: Missing items or rewards from chests / Battle Pass pet box
common_problems.problem_title_ar: اختفاء العناصر أو المكافآت من الصناديق / صندوق حيوانات باتل باس
symptoms: Opened box/chest from Season Rank or Battle Pass and nothing appeared
Selected a pet (e.g., Colorful Dragon) and it didn't come to inventory/chest
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Which box or reward did you open?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
State exact reward/box source
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff checks logs and database regarding reward distribution from season ranks or battle pass boxes.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم طاقم العمل بمراجعة السجلات وقاعدة البيانات بخصوص توزيع المكافآت من رتب المواسم أو صناديق باتل باس.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Escalate to database administrators immediately when a player claims a reward box consumed an item without granting the pet/item.

staff_golden_rules: Always require the player's Character Name (IGN) and clear screenshots before investigating missing items, bugs, or alchemy issues.
Verify whether auto-alchemy functions or specific game systems were used when players report abnormal item enhancement results.
Do not reset PvP entry limits if a player forgot to take a quest, but staff may manually complete the quest as a courtesy if verified.

common_problems.problem_title: Scammed by Imposter/Fake Guild Member
common_problems.problem_title_ar: النصب بواسطة شخص ينتحل صفة عضو في النقابة
symptoms: Player traded valuable items like weapons (+11 / 80% wep) to an imposter thinking it was a guild member (e.g. Steeg)
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Do you have screenshots of the conversation?
required_player_actions: Provide character name (IGN)
Provide screenshots of the conversation
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff verify the logs or report, but generally state there is nothing staff can do if players trade outside official systems due to multiple prior warnings sent through the game and Discord.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يؤكد طاقم العمل أنه لا يمكنهم فعل شيء حيال عمليات النصب خارج النظام الرسمي نظراً لكثرة التحذيرات السابقة عبر اللعبة والديسكورد.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Escalate to management/database admins only if systemic impersonation or alt-character tracing is required.

common_problems.problem_title: Battle Royale Event Ban Inquiries
common_problems.problem_title_ar: الاستفسار عن حظر فعاليات باتل رويال
symptoms: Player cannot register for Battle Royale
Player asking when the Battle Royale ban will be lifted
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is your Character Name (IGN)?
Did you team up during the last battle royale?
required_player_actions: Provide Character Name (IGN)
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Bans resulting from events like Battle Royale (typically for teaming up or rule-breaking) normally last for 7 days automatically.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: الحظر الناتج عن الفعاليات مثل باتل رويال (عادة بسبب التعاون بين اللاعبين أو مخالفة القواعد) يستمر عادة لمدة 7 أيام تلقائياً.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When checking specific event logs and verifying ban expiration timestamps.

common_problems.problem_title: RMT / Real Money Trading (Selling Silk or Items for Cash)
common_problems.problem_title_ar: البيع مقابل أموال حقيقية (بيع الحرير أو الأغراض بالدولار)
symptoms: Player reporting footpets or characters selling silk/items for real money (e.g., 1k silk for $0.9)
Player banned for associating with sellers
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Do you have any screenshots?
What is your main account name / IGN?
required_player_actions: Provide screenshot proofs
Provide main account and character name
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff check logs for transaction links to sellers. Confirmed RMT sellers and associated accounts are permanently banned ('done banned').
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يقوم الطاقم بفحص السجلات للبحث عن روابط مع البائعين. يتم حظر بائعي التجارة الحقيقية والحسابات المرتبطة بهم نهائياً.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When verifying logs between players and known RMT sellers for ban execution.

common_problems.problem_title: In-Game Insults, Free Speech, and Harassment
common_problems.problem_title_ar: الإهانات داخل اللعبة، حرية التعبير، والمضايقات
symptoms: Players reporting insults regarding nationality, family, or personal matters in global chat
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: What is the exact reason or context shown?
Do you have screenshots?
required_player_actions: Provide character names and proof screenshots
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff clarify that punishments/mutes are strictly given for severe violations such as insulting religions and racism; general trash talk or freedom of speech situations are generally not punished with mutes/bans.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يوضح الطاقم أن العقوبات والكتم تُفرض حصرياً على الانتهاكات الخطيرة مثل إهانة الأديان والعنصرية، بينما لا يتم معاقبة الكلام العادي أو مواقف حرية التعبير.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Escalate to senior staff only if hate speech, racism, or religious insults are verified.

common_problems.problem_title: Unsafe Trades and Middleman Policy
common_problems.problem_title_ar: المعاملات غير الآمنة وسياسة الوسيط
symptoms: Player scammed after buying/trading outside official channels
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Did you use the designated middleman?
required_player_actions: Acknowledge server trade policies
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Staff explicitly state: 'We don’t get involved in any purchases unless they go through our designated middleman. And we’ve warned everyone multiple times about this.'
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: يؤكد الطاقم صراحة: 'نحن لا نتدخل في أي عمليات شراء ما لم تمر عبر الوسيط المعتمد لدينا، وقد حذرنا الجميع عدة مرات من ذلك.'
common_problems.when_to_escalate: Only handle character/item trades when using the official Exilium MiddleMan ticketing system.

staff_golden_rules: Never get involved in player purchases, trades, or item loans unless transactions go through the official designated middleman.
Strictly enforce bans for Real Money Trading (RMT), silk selling, and alt-accounts linked to sellers after checking database logs.
Punishments and mutes for chat violations are strictly reserved for racism and insulting religions; standard trash talk or freedom of speech is not punishable.
Battle Royale and event bans for rule-breaking (such as teaming up) typically last for 7 days automatically.
Always require clear screenshots and exact Character Names (IGN) from players before taking moderation actions or executing bans.

common_problems.problem_title: BSObj Plugin Error / Game Not Opening
common_problems.problem_title_ar: خطأ BSObj Plugin أو عدم فتح اللعبة
symptoms: BSObj Plugin error message appears when trying to open the game
Clicking the launcher does nothing
Clicking ExiliumClient.exe directly triggers the error or fails
diagnostic_questions_to_ask_player: Can you show me which file you click to open the game?
What is the exact error code or can you send a screenshot of the error message?
required_player_actions: Open the game from Silkroad.exe (or sro_client.exe) instead of ExiliumClient.exe
Check Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc) to close any stuck background processes
For Windows 11: Right-click desktop -> Display settings -> Graphics -> Browse to select sro_client.exe, set to 'High performance', and check 'Don't use optimizations for windowed games'
common_problems.actual_solution_en: Do not launch the game using ExiliumClient.exe. Instead, launch it using silkroad.exe or sro_client.exe. If using Windows 11, configure graphics performance settings for sro_client.exe, and ensure any lingering background processes are terminated via Task Manager.
common_problems.actual_solution_ar: لا تقم بتشغيل اللعبة باستخدام ExiliumClient.exe. بدلاً من ذلك، قم بتشغيلها باستخدام silkroad.exe أو sro_client.exe. إذا كنت تستخدم ويندوز 11، قم بضبط إعدادات الأداء الرسومي لملف sro_client.exe، وتأكد من إيقاف أي عمليات عالقة في الخلفية عبر مدير المهام.
common_problems.when_to_escalate: When standard execution fixes fail and there is an unknown technical crash with no exact information available

staff_golden_rules: Always ask for a screenshot or the exact error message before attempting troubleshooting
Verify which specific executable file the player is clicking to launch the game
Ensure Windows Defender exclusions and system requirements are checked for installation issues
